note: Test identities that may disappear from test-manifest.json. Every entry needs a reason and an owner issue; the gate fails on an entry that still exists, so the list cannot rot.

removed.src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the Tinker,: Renamed to 'the Tinker has a death step on the first night, the Po and the Shabaloth from the second, and the Po's takes three players after a night it chose no one (BMR-TINKER-01, BMR-PO-01, BMR-SHABALOTH-01)': Tinker r1782 allows the death at any time, including the first night (#218).
removed.src/core/roles/tinker/role.test.ts::the: Renamed to 'the Tinker module declares a step on every night and ends nothing on use (BMR-TINKER-01)': Tinker r1782 allows the death at any time, so the first night has the same step (#218).
